note: Acceptance cases only. Model/host/browser evaluations remain not_run unless an explicit record is supplied.

cases.scenario: A PNG has an unusual aspect ratio and its sidebar label conflicts with the current PRD name.
cases.expected: Preserve visual hierarchy, use the PRD name and route, and adapt responsive layout without zoom or hidden overflow.

cases.scenario: A visual change is implemented with image-to-html unavailable or optional helpers missing.
cases.expected: Use the OMNX integration profile, existing stack/assets, and a safe available fallback; do not claim conversion or add a parallel frontend.

cases.scenario: A trusted direct host session begins a clear implementation without a wrapper.
cases.expected: Create/reuse one canonical Task, attempt Console open once, and keep implementation going when browser launch is false.

cases.scenario: A user requests only explanation or review with project hooks installed.
cases.expected: Do not create a Task, journal, update request, or Console launch.

cases.scenario: Two host sessions start implementation simultaneously in one worktree, or one session identity appears in two clones.
cases.expected: Parallel sessions and worktree journals remain separate; bounded retries recover temporary metadata lock contention.

cases.scenario: Host interrupt or session end arrives, then the user returns after a long idle period.
cases.expected: Leave a checkpoint, preserve Task state, and show stale activity as unconfirmed.

cases.scenario: Update checking is disabled or network is unavailable.
cases.expected: Keep installed runtime usable and do not initiate a request without opt-in.

cases.scenario: An RC is published while channel is stable, or an asset has an incorrect digest.
cases.expected: Keep RC out of stable and reject bytes that do not match the release digest.

cases.scenario: A compatible update is downloaded during a session.
cases.expected: Validate and stage beside the active version; do not switch the host or project lock mid-session.

cases.scenario: A short task changes an authorization or isolation boundary.
cases.expected: Recommend advanced based on risk, while keeping requested/effective model and cost separately observable.

cases.scenario: The configured model or effort is not supported by the current host.
cases.expected: Mark effective selection unknown and use only an authorized host choice without repeated cheap retries.

cases.scenario: The Console modal is open during the existing periodic refresh.
cases.expected: Keep selection/focus/scroll stable and distinguish Task state, session signal, client presence, and package versions.

cases.scenario: Console launch fails after Task recording succeeds.
cases.expected: Preserve Task and journal; report browser/client state honestly and do not block implementation.

cases.scenario: A release archive is extracted into a clean directory.
cases.expected: Package manifest, Console manifest and file inventory agree; project schema remains compatible.

cases.scenario: No release is newer, or the official request times out.
cases.expected: Keep the installed version and report no update or unavailable without blocking project work.

cases.scenario: A candidate does not support the adopted project schema.
cases.expected: Mark it incompatible and keep it out of the staged package path.
